tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ྈrtsa gsum thugs sgrub dbang chen 'dus pa las:bkra shis gter sgrub kyi las byang bde legs kun 'byung bzhugs so:
ྈrtsa gsum thugs sgrub dbang chen 'dus pa las:bkra shis gter sgrub kyi las byang bde legs kun 'byung bzhugs so:

tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ rtsa gsum thugs sgrub dbang chen 'dus pa las: bkra shis gter sgrub kyi las byang bde legs kun 'byung bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rtsa gsum dbang gi lha la 'dud: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: bkra shis gter gyi sgrub pa yi: mchod bstod bde legs kun 'byung bstan: dung shel gser dngul rin chen snod: dkar mngar 'bru bcud sbyar ba'i bshos: rtsi sman 'bras dkar g.yag lug ra: bsang spos mchod rdzas gang 'byor bsham: dril gsil ting ting dung dkar dang: gling bu 'bud cing rgyud mang sbreng: snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis spyan 'dren bya: hūm̐: ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi: bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas rnams: dad pas bdag gis spyan 'dren na: thugs rjes dgongs nas gshegs su gsol: e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā sa pa ri bā ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: kye: stong gsum 'jig rten khams rnams na: gnas shing rten bcas sa bdag klu: lha mo brtan mas gtso byas pa'i: lha klu dge bsnyen sa bdag dang: yul lha gzhi bdag ma lus pa: rnal 'byor bdag gis spyan 'dren gyis: 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: khyed rnams rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan: rgya mtsho chu klung ri brag nags: sa dang bar snang kun gyi bdag: legs nyes gnyis kyi shan 'byed cing: 'gro ba mi dang lhan cig gnas: mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: kun gsal dgyes pa'i mdangs dang ldan: 'gro la brtse ba'i shugs kyis ni: ma thogs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sngon gyi dam tshig tshul bzhin du: las kyi 'bras bu mchis par stsol: bum pa ti sa pa ri bā ra pṛ thi dhe wī lo ka tā ra tri sa ma ya srog dung dung tri ā kar+sha ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings kyi rgyal ba thugs rje can: byin rlabs dngos grub char ltar 'beb: srid par 'dzin pa'i bdag rtog dri: ye shes chen po'i klong du dag: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid lhun rdzogs gyur: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐: bzhugs gsol ni:

hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba sras dang bcas: bdag sogs 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: 'ja' tshon spel legs bkod 'dra ba'i: gzhal med khang mdzes dam pa 'dir: pad+ma nyi zla dgyes pa'i khrir: 'gro don mdzad phyir bzhugs su gsol: oṃ bha ga bān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ā be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya hūm̐: phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku: sna tshogs 'phro 'dus 'gro don dpag med mdzad: mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba: rab brjid lhun po de la phyag 'tshal lo: gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i sgra sgrog cing: gdul bya rnams la chos kyi bdud rtsi 'beb: bdud dang mu stegs rigs rnams skrag par mdzad: snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs de la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pa'i 'od zer gyis: 'gro rnams skyong zhing byang chub lam la bkod: thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i: rnam dag dri med de la phyag 'tshal lo: rol rtsal ma 'gags snod du shar ba'i gzugs: sa la gnas pa'i sems ma sa 'dzin bdag: phyi nang dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i dam tshig can: sprul dang yang sprul bcas la phyag 'tshal lo: na mo a ti pū ho: mchod pa ni: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus kyi: nyon mongs tsha gdung las skyob phyir: bsil ldan zhi gnas thob slad du: rnam dag mchod yon 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza āḥhūm̐: des 'gres: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus kyi: glo bur dri ma spang phyir dang: rnam dag ye shes thob bya'i phyir: zhabs bsil dam pa 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pra wa ra sata ka ra pra tīts+tsha pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus kyi: gzugs ngan gzugs rgyu'i skyon bsal nas: mtshan bzang dpe byad thob bya'i phyir: mdangs ldan me tog 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza āḥhūm̐:

hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus kyi: gzung 'dzin tshor ba'i dri spang zhing: tshul khrims dri bzang thob bya'i phyir: rnam dag bdug spos 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta dhū pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus kyi: gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas: ye shes 'od gsal thob bya'i phyir: snang gsal sgron me 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus kyi: gzung 'dzin dri ma spong phyir dang: mi rtog ye shes thob slad du: dri mchog dam pa 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus kyi: bkres skom log 'tsho'i zas spang zhing: yid bzhin zas mchog thob bya'i phyir: zhal zas dam pa 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta nai bid+yā pra tīts+tsha pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus kyi: 'khor ba ngan song spang phyir dang: zhing khams rnam dag thob bya'i phyir: yid bzhin maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍa la pra tīts+tsha pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus kyi: log pa'i dri ma spang ba'i phyir: tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs thob slad du: rol mo sil snyan 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang: sa bdag sa 'dzin klu chen brgyad: lo zla zhag tshes 'byung ba'i lha: khyad par 'dzam gling yul gru skyong: mgul lha dge bsnyen brtan ma sogs: sde brgyad dregs pa'i rigs gyur pa: mkha' la rgyu dang rang bzhin gnas: srid rtse mnar med yan chad kyi: srid par gtogs pa thams cad la: 'jig rten bkra shis phun tshogs phyir: 'dod yon mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul: dkar gsum rdzas kyi mchod pa 'bul: mngar gsum bcud kyi mchod pa 'bul: rang rang dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul:

'bras dkar g.yag lug ra gsum 'bul: smyug rgod dar sna rin chen 'bul: gser g.yu sman spos 'bru sna 'bul: bla rdo rten rdzas mda' dar 'bul: phye mar chang phud shing 'bras 'bul: mkhan shug sur dkar bsang dud 'bul: 'jig rten srid pa'i nor dang bcud: gser ri rol mtsho gling bzhi dang: lcags ri nyi zla gza' rgyu skar: mkha' la lding dang sa la 'dzul: bar du 'phyo dang chu la gnas: srid pa'i gzugs 'gros thams cad 'bul: rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rdzas: lha mi'i 'dod yon ma lus pa: mang por ting nge 'dzin gyis spel: so sor thob pa sngags rgyas bsgyur: gzhi bdag khyed rnams spyan snga ru: ci 'dod mkho dgu ldan gyur cig: khyed rnams dgyes shing tshims gyur nas: bdag gi 'dod pa'i don rnams sgrubs: gling 'dir bkra shis dge legs spel: zas nor longs spyod dngos grub stsol: las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: bum pa ti sa pa ri bā ra pṛ thi dhe wī lo ka tā ra sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku yi bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das: gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings ngang: byang chub mchog dang 'khor lo'i phyag: rab 'byams sku yi dpal 'bar ba: dkar gsal thugs rje'i 'od 'phro zhing: sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyang: rnam snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: gsung gi bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das: 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtog ngang: mnyam nyid pad+ma'i phyag rgya can: rab 'byams gsung gi dpal 'bar ba: dmar gsal thugs rje'i 'od 'phro zhing: mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i dbugs dbyung mdzad: 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi: thugs kyi bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das: zhe sdang rnam dag me long ngang: mnyam gzhag sa gnon rdo rje'i phyag: rab 'byams thugs kyi dpal 'bar ba: sngo sangs thugs rje'i 'od 'phro zhing:

ngan song thams cad sbyong mdzad pa: mi bskyod rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi: yon tan bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das: nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid ngang: mchog sbyin mnyam gzhag rin chen phyag: rab 'byams yon tan dpal 'bar ba: gser mdog thugs rje'i 'od 'phro zhing: yid bzhin re ba ma lus skong: rin chen 'byung la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: phrin las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das: phrag dog bya grub ye shes ngang: skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag rgya gram phyag: rab 'byams phrin las dpal 'bar ba: ljang gsal thugs rje'i 'od 'phro zhing: 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun sel mdzad: don yod grub la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rigs kyi yum mchog lha mo'i sku: rgyan rnams kun gyis legs spras shing: gzugs mdzes mnyen lcug 'khril ldem can: dgyes mdzad yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: nam mkha' rnam dag dbyings phyug ma: me khams rnam dag gos dkar mo: chu khams rnam dag mā ma kī: sa khams rnam dag sangs rgyas spyan: rlung khams rnam dag dam tshig sgrol: kun kyang 'gro ba'i rtog sgrib sbyong: thugs rje mi zad dpal 'bar ma: lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzhan yang bstod 'os bsngags pa'i mchog: sangs rgyas chos tshogs byang chub sems: phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med na: bzhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum mkhyen ldan bla ma rje: dran pa tsam gyis nyon mongs 'joms: 'gro ba'i dpal mgon rin po che: bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhi dang khro tshul du ma'i bdag: dngos grub kun gyi mdzod chen po: dpa' gtum rngam pa'i cha lugs can: yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: mthu stobs mnga' bdag log 'dren 'dul: khro zhing gtum pa'i cha lugs can: srin po'i gzugs can sprul pa 'gyed: dam can tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mdor na bstod par 'os pa yi: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i: lha dang sprul pa yang sprul bcas:

gtso 'khor rnams la gus pas bstod: rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing kun gyi: bde gshegs rgyal ba sras dang bcas: thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pa'i 'od: 'gro rnams byang chub lam la 'god: gdul bya mthar phyin mchog la bstod: thugs rje brtse ldan lha tshogs rnams: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag gis 'gro ba sems can don: rmad byung phrin las 'di brtsams pas: mkhyen brtse mdzad pa'i phrin las kyi: gzigs pas nye bar gzigs su gsol: bdag sogs 'gro ba sems can gyi: sdig sgrib bag chags dag pa dang: nyon mongs 'khrul 'khor gzhom du gsol: 'byung bzhi dus kyi chad pa dang: nad gdon dgra bgegs glo bur rkyen: nag po bdud kyi cho 'phrul rnams: thugs rje'i dpung gis zhi bar mdzod: dge bcu'i yon tan rgyas pa dang: gnas skabs mthar thug don 'bras kun: rtsol med lhun gyis grub par gsol: phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du: bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs shing: 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob gsol: zhes bstod 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol: spyi gzhung rigs lnga gcig dril sngags: bzlas rjes rnam snang gzungs 'di 'o: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te: sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni: rā dzā ya: ta thā ga tā ya: ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya: tad+ya thā: oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni: shud+dhe bi shud+dhe: sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā: mi bskyod rdo rje sems dpa'i sngags: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: ma nu pā lā ya: badz+ra satwa twe no pa: tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa: su toṣ+yo me bha wa: a nu rak+to me bha wa: su poṣ+yo me bha wa: sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha: sarba karma su tsa me: tsit+taṃ shre yāṃḥku ru hūm̐: ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga bān: sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+rī bha ba: ma hā sa ma ya satwa ā: mgon po 'od mi 'khrugs pa'i sngags: na mo rat+na tra yā ya: oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni:

ro tsa ni ro tsa ni: tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni: trā sa ni trā sa ni: pra ti ha na pra ti ha na: sarba karma pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me: sarba satwa nāñtsa swā hā: snang mtha' 'od dpag med pa'i sngags: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na su bi niṣitsa ta te dzo rā dzā ya: ta thā ga tā ya: ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya: tad+ya thā: oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye ma hā puṇ+ye: a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye: a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye: dzñā na saṃ bhā ro pa tsi te: oṃ sarba saṃskā ra pa ri shud+dha dharma te: ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shud+dhe: ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā: phrin las don grub sman bla'i sngags: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te bhai ṣa dz+yai: gu ru bai ḍūr+ya pra bhā rā dzā ya: ta thā ga tā ya: ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya: tad+ya thā: oṃ bhai ṣa dz+yai bhai ṣa dz+yai: ma hā bhai ṣa dz+yai rā dzā sa mut+ga te swā hā: rnam 'joms sngags ni: na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya: hu lu hu lu: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha: bhan+dha bhan+dha: ha na ha na a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa: sme brtsegs ni: oṃ bhurkuṃ ma hā pra ṇā ya: bhurtsi bhurki bi ma le u tsuṣ+ma kro ta rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: rtsa ba gsum gyi snying po: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: dbyangs gsal: oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ a: ka kha ga gha nga tsa tsha dza dzha nya ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ta tha da dha na pa pha ba bha ma ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa: rten 'brel snying po: oṃ ye dharmā he tu+u pra bha bāḥhe tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba dat: te ṣañtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥye swā hā: rdzogs chen 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bstan pa bu gcig gi rgyud yongs rdzogs sam: bsdu na: ma ma ko ling sa man+ta: zhes bzlas kyang rung: sangs rgyas rtse mo'i gzungs ni: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: brtan ma'i rig pa:

tad+ya thā: oṃ tsi ri tsi ri: tsu ru tsu ru: ku ru ku ru: do tsu do tsu: ba ha ba ha: bha sha bha sha swā hā: brtan ma gtso 'khor yang dril ni: oṃ ma ma kyed kyed pā ṇi he: ku lan ṇig nal ting ting shag shag rā ga phe sha dzaḥdza: klu dang gnod sbyin brgyad ni gzhan du gsal zhing: snang brgyad: oṃ a ka ni: ni ka ni: a bhi la: maṇ+ḍa la ma ye swā hā: de ltar snod bcud kyi 'byung ba'i chad pa zhi ba la byin che ba rigs lnga la sogs pa'i gzungs gtso bor bzla: sa bcud spel zhing lo legs par 'dod pa la brtan ma dang: 'khrug rtsod zhi ba la snang brgyad gtsor byas te bzla: thun mtshams su mchod bstod bya ba ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten stong khams 'di'am gzhan dag na: dngos su 'byor bshams yid 'ong rnam sprul pa: mchod pa'i bye brag rnam mang rgya chen po: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa: lha mi'i longs spyod dpal 'byor ci mchis pa: 'khor 'das dbyer med rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: blo yis blangs te gus pas 'bul lags na: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: thugs rjes brtse ba'i phrin las mngon phyungs la: srid par 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa: byams ldan thugs rjes rtag tu skyob pa dang: bla med byang chub gnas su lam sna drongs: lhun grub bde chen sa la 'god par gsol: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she sarba pū dza sa ma ye swā hā: hūm̐: grangs med gong nas sangs rgyas kyang: 'gro ba'i don du sems ma'i tshul: sems can 'dod pa'i don sgrub ma: 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid: sa yi lha mo'i rang bzhin can: 'jig rten skyong ba sa yi bdag: dbyings phyug spyan mar phyag 'tshal bstod: gling bzhir dbang bsgyur stobs kyi bdag: gser mdog rin chen rgyan gyis spras: gter bum bsam 'phel 'dod 'byung gter: yid bzhin re skong mdzad la bstod:

shar phyogs shing gi gzhal yas nas: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid: shing gi lha mo'i rang bzhin can: sngon mo shing dang rdo rje 'dzin: shing gi lha dang lha mos bskor: mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: lho phyogs me yi gzhal yas nas: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid: me yi lha mo'i rang bzhin can: dmar mo snang gsal rin chen 'dzin: me yi lha dang lha mos bskor: mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: nub phyogs lcags kyi gzhal yas nas: pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid: lcags kyi lha mo'i rang bzhin can: dkar mo lcags sgrog pad+ma 'dzin: lcags kyi lha dang lha mos bskor: mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: byang phyogs chu yi gzhal yas nas: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid: chu yi lha mo'i rang bzhin can: nag po chu bum rgya gram 'dzin: chu yi lha dang lha mos bskor: mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: thugs rje'i 'od las sprul pa yi: phan gnod las kun mdzad pa'i lha: stong gsum gzhi bdag lha klu gnyan: 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'byung ba dbyings kyi yum chen lnga: thugs rjes 'byung ba'i stobs skyed la: 'byung ba thams cad dbang du sdus: 'byung ba bcud kyi dngos grub stsol: 'dzam gling 'jig rten yul gru 'dir: 'byung ba'i bu ru gyur pa'i 'gro: lha klu mi yi tshe dpal stobs: 'dod dgu phun sum tshogs par spel: bkra shis dge legs rgyas par mdzod: sngon tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das: sa la brten nas byang chub brnyes: lha mo khyod ni dpang por gyur: bdud btul bkra shis bstan pa rgyas: lha mi kun gyi longs spyod kyang: sa la brten nas 'dod dgu 'byung: dpal bcu'i mnga' thang thams cad bskyed: rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal: lha mo khyod la rtag tu 'dud: sngon tshe bcom ldan spyan snga ru: thugs bskyed rang gis dam bca' phul: oṃ: lha mi'i phan bde'i longs spyod rgyas:

nor zas gter dang bdud rtsi 'byung: tshe ring nad med dgra rgol gzhom: thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur: gnas gtsang dkyil 'khor bya ba dang: khrus gtsang gos gsar gyon byas nas: sku gsung rnam dag rten drung 'dug: spos dang me tog kha zas mchod: rnal 'byor dam tshig gtsang na 'grub: de skad khyod kyis zhal bzhes pas: bdag ni bcom ldan de yi sras: 'od gsal dgongs rgyud 'dzin pa yin: 'gro ba sems can kun gyi don: dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bzhin du: sku gsung thugs kyi gzi brjid skyed: phyi nang 'byung ba'i rten 'brel rtsal: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis brlabs: rmad byung byang chub spyod pa mchog: sa gzhi 'di yi steng spyad pas: lha mos dpang mdzod mthu dpung skyed: sngon gyi thugs dam ci bzhin du: bdag cag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas dang: 'dzam gling mi yi 'dod pa kun: rtsol med lhun gyis grub par mdzod: tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor stobs: dge legs yon tan rgyud la spel: 'gro rnams chos la spyod pa dang: sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: dgra bgegs bdud dpung pham pa dang: nad gdon 'khrug rtsod mu ge zhi: yul ris rgyal khams thams cad du: bkra shis phun sum tshogs par mdzod:

ces 'dod don gsol: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de ltar sgrub pa'i bum pa de: dus tshes gza' skar bzang po'i thebs: gang dmigs yul ris sa gnad du: lto 'phye brtan ma rtsis la bru: rgya dpangs gnas yul skabs dang sbyar: rdo sgrom nang gzhug sol bas bkang: phyi nang rten 'brel gsal ba'i ngang: hūm̐: srid pa dang po gang nas srid: dbyings las thabs kyi 'od lnga shar: yul lnga'i 'dzin pas thugs rje'i rtsal: phyi nang snod bcud 'jig rten grub: srid pa'i mes po tshangs pa yis: 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud nor bu'i tshogs: mi zad dpal gyi gter du sbas: srid pa'i khra brgyad gter bdag bskos: lha dang mi dang lha min klu: dpal 'byor bde skyid phun sum tshogs: bskal bzang stong gi gdul zhing gyur: de 'og lha dbang brgya byin dang: rgyal po chen po sde bzhi yis: ri rgyal lhun po'i steng 'og bar: nor bu'i gter kha dpag med sbas: gter bdag gnod sbyin dzam+bha la: thugs rje smon lam dbang gis grub: lha rnams kun gyi tshe dpal rgyas: 'phags pa 'jam dpal gdul zhing gyur: klu rgyal mtha' yas 'jog po yis: mtsho gling nor bu'i gter sbas pas: snang gsal gzi byin bde skyid ldan: spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing gyur: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yis: klong lnga mi shigs gsang sgrom du: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i chos gter sbas: mi zad theg pa'i mdzod klong rdol: dpa' bo lag na rdo rje yis: gsang sngags ston pa'i gdul zhing gyur: sangs rgyas sems can mnyam par sbyor: ngo mtshar rten 'brel rmad du byung: de nas gangs can bod kyi yul: sngags 'chang pad+ma thod phreng gis: sa gzhi byin brlabs lha srin btul: 'byung ba bcud kyi gter sbas pas: chos rgyal mnga' ris rgyas pa dang: mdo sngags chos kyi sgron me sbar: sngon byung rten 'brel ji bzhin du: da lta rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyis: nad mtshon dus 'khrug zhi ba dang:

char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs legs: bstan pa rgyas dang sde srid brtan: 'jig rten bkra shis dge legs phyir: rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa yi: 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gter chen 'di: sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha' dbyings su: mi nub bstan pa'i btsas su sbas: sngon gyi thugs dam deng dgongs la: 'dzam gling yul gru sa phyogs 'dir: 'byung ba lnga yi bcud sdus la: yul 'di'i sa bcud rgyas pa dang: tshe dpal ting 'dzin nyams rtogs spel: bkra shis dge legs rgyas par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: lha mi'i skyob pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das: bdag dang 'gro la thugs rjes brtser dgongs la: nye bar gzung phyir sa yi kha phye mdzod: bkra shis sa yi lha mo'i mkha' dbyings su: 'byung lnga'i srog gter snod bcud dpal gyi gzhi: snying po lnga dang dar sna 'bru sna lnga: sman lnga rin chen lnga dang man shel dang: a ti'i srog rgyud sngags dang phyag rgya'i gter: ri rgyal lhun po nyi zla rgyu skar sogs: lha klu yul gyi gzhi bdag bla srog rten: rmad byung dam rdzas bla med zab gsang gter: rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i gter chen 'dis: bdag sogs 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du: dpal bcu'i dbang thang smin grol zab lam sogs: tshad med rin chen gter la spyod par shog: snying po rnam pa lnga yi gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: yul phyogs 'di dang rgyal khams thams cad du: snod bcud dpal skyed sku lnga'i byin ldan shog: 'bru sna lnga yi gter chen 'di sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can ma lus pa: bkres phongs mu ge'i bskal pa zhi bar shog: sman mchog rnam pa lnga yi gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can ma lus pa: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad gdon zhi bar shog: lcags sogs mtshon cha lnga yi gter sbas pas:

dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: yul phyogs 'di dang rgyal khams thams cad du: dmag 'khrug mtshon cha'i bskal pa zhi bar shog: rin chen rnam pa lnga yi gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can ma lus pa: 'dod yon lnga la rtag tu longs spyod shog: dar zab rnam pa lnga yi gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can ma lus pa: ngo tsha khrel ldan gos kyis mdzes par shog: dri spos rnam pa lnga yi gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: 'jig rten khams su dge 'dun sde rgyas shing: tshul khrims sdom gtsang phar phyin drug ldan shog: 'chi med bdud rtsi sman gyi gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can ma lus pa: nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog tshogs zhi bar shog: kun 'byung zab mo chos kyi gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: yul phyogs 'di dang rgyal khams thams cad du: sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen rgyas par shog: rdul tshon ye shes lnga yi gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: gsang sngags spyod pas 'jig rten kun khyab cing: tshogs gnyis mkhyen brtse'i yon tan rgyas par shog: ye shes rang gsal man shel gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: yul phyogs 'di dang 'dzam gling khor yug tu: rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub brgyud bstan dar shog: ye grol dgongs gsang srog rgyud gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: yul phyogs 'di dang 'dzam gling khor yug tu: rdzogs chen a ti'i bstan pa rgyas par shog: sku gdung ring bsrel mchog gi gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la:

yul phyogs 'di dang srid pa'i khams kun tu: zhing khams rigs lngas rtag tu byin rlobs shog: yon tan kun 'byung rtsi sman gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: yul phyogs 'di dang 'dzam gling khor yug gi: lha klu'i stobs skyed 'jig rten bde bar shog: bskal bzang g.yang zhag rol mtsho'i gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: yul phyogs 'di dang gling bzhi srid pa'i khyon: char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs legs par shog: byin ldan gnas chen gangs brag gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: yul phyogs 'di dang gling bzhi srid pa'i khyon: bkra shis dge legs phun tshogs rgyas par shog: lha klu gzhi bdag bla rten gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: yul phyogs 'di dang rgyal khams thams cad du: bkra shis mi nor btsan phyug dar bar shog: rin chen ri rgyal lhun po'i gter sbas pas: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis: ci 'dod 'bad rtsol med par lhun grub shog: 'byung ba kun 'dus yid bzhin srid pa'i gter: dbyings phyug spyan mas 'gyur med rgya sdoms la: snod bcud dpal skyed lha klu mi gsum gyi: tshe dpal ting 'dzin ye shes rgyas par shog: snod bcud rgyan rdzogs bum pa'i gter chen 'dis: phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas bstan pa mchog: kun nas kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang: nyon mongs log 'dren bdud tshogs mi ldang zhing: phyogs dus gnas skabs dge legs rgyas par shog: zhes spyi dang: bye brag dge 'dun gyi sde spel ba la: dkon mchog gsum gyi phyag rgya yid bzhin gter: mi zad 'dod dgu'i dpal mchog rgya mtsho 'dis: phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs: gnas 'dir 'du zhing brgya stong khri 'bum dang:

bye ba ther 'bum bgrang yas 'phel rgyas nas: stong gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yi: 'dus sde 'gyur med rtag brtan srid mtha'i bar: 'gro don mtha' ru phyin pa'i bkra shis shog: sngags sde spel ba la: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i mthu stobs kyis: rten 'brel phyag rgya mi zad dpal gyi gter: thugs rje'i rang bzhin khams gsum srid pa'i 'gro: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas: rig 'dzin 'dus pa tshom bu 'bum sde yis: 'jig rten khams kun dog por rab rgyas nas: rdo rje theg mchog bka' btsan byin che zhing: bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nub med sgreng ba dang: bskal par 'dus sde mi 'gyur brtan par shog: rgyal po'i mnga' thang bskyed pa la: rtsa gsum dkon mchog byin rlabs bslu med mthus: nam yang mi nub rten 'brel dpal gyi gter: dgos 'byung bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po 'dis: khams gsum chos kyi rgyal srid dbang bsgyur zhing: stobs kyis lha 'dre mi gsum 'khol ba dang: mtha' bzhi'i dpal 'byor 'dod dgu rtsol med du: yongs su 'du zhing bka' yi gnyer 'dzin pas: rgyal khams kun kyang rtag tu bde bar shog: skye bo'i 'du tshogs spel na: rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs phyag rgya'i mthu: khyab 'jug rlung zhags pho nya myur ba'i stobs: rten 'brel gter mchog mi nub dpal 'bar bas: 'jig rten srid pa'i lha 'dre mi gsum dang: bla ma dbu gtso dge bshes dge 'dun dang: rgyal blon btsun 'bangs skye bo pho mo 'bangs: pho brang yul gling rta phyugs zas dang nor: rin chen nor bu dkor cha'i bye brag rnams: gnas 'dir 'du zhing rgya cher 'phel ba dang: srid pa'i khams na mngon par mtho ba yi: che btsan 'gran zla bral ba'i dpal skyed cig: rigs rgyud spel na: rtsa gsum lha dang mkha' 'gro dam can gyi: mthu stobs bden pa'i gter mchog yid bzhin dpal: bstan pa'i srog shing rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin pa'i:

rigs rgyud srid kyi dpal mtsho rab rgyas shing: bde skyid lha dang 'byor ldan gnod sbyin bu: 'phan phyug klu dang gter ldan nor lha'i bu: pha mes rigs rgyud chad med srid kyi bu: nyi zla ltar gsal rgyu skar bzhin bkra ba'i: bkra shis dpal phun chu bo'i rgyun ltar stsol: bstan pa mi nub rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: chos rgyud spel ba dge 'dun dang mtshungs so: tshe spel ba ni: rtsa gsum 'chi med bde ldan mgon po bzhin: bdag skyob lha dang drang srong bden stobs kyis: rten 'brel phyag rgya mi nub tshe yi gter: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dbyings su rgyas btab pas: bdag cag rgyu sbyor skal ldan rig 'dzin la: nyi zla'i tshe stsol g.yung drung lta bur gyur: bskal bzang stong gi bstan pa srid mtha'i bar: tshe gcig bya ba byed pa'i yon tan ldan: rdo rje'i tshe srog lhun brjid ri rab ltar: dpal bcu'i mnga' thang rgya mtsho chen por skyil: mkhyen brtse'i mthu rtsal nus pa me ltar sbor: dbang bsgyur stobs ldan kun khyab rlung bzhin du: srid gsum stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba yis: bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog: de nas kha gcod dgab cing rlan gyis mi 'jig par byas la rgyas btab pa ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs thugs kyi byin rlabs las: rdo rje 'bar bas rgyas btab pas: mi 'gyur mi shigs rtag brtan cing: klong yangs thugs kyi bkra shis shog: trāṃ: bde gshegs yon tan byin rlabs las: rin chen 'bar bas rgyas btab pas: 'khor 'das lam gsum nus stobs rgyas: zad med yon tan bkra shis shog: hrī: bde gshegs gsung gi byin rlabs las: pad+ma 'bar bas rgyas btab pas: chags med skyon bral yon tan rdzogs: 'gag med gsung gi bkra shis shog: ā: bde gshegs phrin las byin rlabs las: ral gri 'bar bas rgyas btab pas: bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing: phrin las mthar phyin bkra shis shog:

oṃ: bde gshegs sku yi byin rlabs las: 'khor lo 'bar bas rgyas btab pas: nyon mongs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhi: 'gyur med sku yi bkra shis shog: phyag rgya lnga yi byin rlabs kyis: tshogs gnyis rgya chen 'phel ba dang: sangs rgyas bstan pa rab dar zhing: 'gro kun bde skyid dpal 'byor ldan: kun kyang chos la spyod pa yi: bstan pa'i btsas su 'di gyur cig: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma bud+dha ā yuḥrat+na sid+dhi bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ su badz+rā ya swā hā: rten 'brel snying po bkra shis brjod: lam pra brtag cing rten 'brel bsgrig: snod rnams sa rdo chus bkang la: dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rang gnas log: dkar chos dge ba'i mthu dpung skyed: gang brtsam rten 'brel mthar phyin 'gyur: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra thugs mchog rdo rje rtsal gyis 'phying bar bang so dmar po nas spyan drangs pa'o/// /
